name: 奉仕への担当者招待
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One Lighthouse component LH11-0005 奉仕への担当者招待: the BASE invitation dialog only. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy screenshot takes priority for original close glyph, selector caret, proportions, alignment, spacing and fine controls; do not reproduce rough mock glyph substitutes. Image2 is SECONDARY Japanese content/layout guide. Image3 approved bus is a white-surface/forest-gradient style reference only.
The source screenshot contains an open candidate dropdown, but that candidate list is a SEPARATE catalog component LH11-0006. This image is only the base dialog in the catalog's saved CLOSED-selector state, with the complete existing Japanese control set. Do not copy background schedule, dropdown candidate list or English source copy into this component. The original footer is obscured by that separate dropdown; keep the existing saved dialog action and do not infer additional controls.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas; single compact white rounded dialog (logical390x330 proportions, high-resolution rendering), fine neutral border and gentle soft downward shadow. Header left Meiryo Bold20/28 「奉仕へ招待する」, right modest close X with faithful original cross geometry in slate #526173. Below a compact WHITE summary with fine neutral outline: bold 「10月22日（木）13:30–15:00」 and regular 「案内チーム・ライトハウス」. Avoid the mock's broad gray filled rectangle. Then bold label 「このチームの担当者」, white selector with fine forest-green focus outline, placeholder 「担当者を選択」 and a small downward triangular caret derived from the original's compact triangle, reversed for the saved closed state. Bottom-left primary button 「招待を送る」.
Preserve the exact Japanese text, date/time, one selector, close control and action. Meiryo14/24 regular body, 12/16 metadata, zero tracking, preserved role sizes and line wrapping; no all-bold text. Small consistent original glyph proportions, precise baseline/padding alignment. Source purple focused selector/close/action is adapted to forest-green focus/action, with close kept slate. Button uses smooth135-degree #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient, white readable label, gentle edge light, restrained shadow. No extra accents because no status or comparative categories occur in this base component. No mint fill, colored avatar, rainbow form icons, decorative artwork, invented counts or new actions. Raster design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画とモックを実見し、閉じた招待本体を生成。候補一覧は別ID0006の範囲。原画優先で小さな三角キャレット/X形状を整え、紫の選択/操作を森林緑、Xをスレートへ適応。日本語/日時/役割/ラベル/選択欄/招待操作保持、白面、切れなし確認。原画では下部が候補に隠れており本体操作は保存モック由来。正確なフォント同定・実操作は未検証。画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
